Timers

Keep your event on track with an accurate timer and rundown.

Build your schedule item by item, pick the right kind of timer for each moment and watch progress on the live one.

  • Duration, Target Time and Time Warp timers
  • Link timers so one flows into the next
  • Warning and critical alerts with their own chimes and flashes
  • Timer rules: show a message, flash the stage or change the colour at a set time remaining
  • Import a CSV, or save whole shows as .onfloo files
Your rundownWhat the stage sees
Messages

Talk to the stage without saying a word.

Send a quick message in one click or type your own. Messages can flash to grab attention and clear themselves.

  • Quick messages ready to go, edit them to suit you
  • Schedule a message to appear in a few minutes and remove itself
  • Focused and immersive modes for messages that can’t be missed
  • Auto-flash and auto-clear options

FAQ

Questions, answered.

What is Onfloo?

A free stage timer and show controller. You build a rundown, run the timers and send messages and timing to your displays.

Is Onfloo only for churches?

No. It works for any live event: conferences, services, concerts, broadcasts, rehearsals and more.

Is it really free?

Yes. Using Onfloo costs nothing. Donations are optional and never unlock features.

What is the dynamic bar?

A live status bar at the top of the controller. It shows the running timer, what’s next, warnings, overtime and confirmations like “Timer started”.

Can messages appear automatically?

Yes. You can schedule a quick message to appear a few minutes from now and remove itself after a set time.

Does it need the internet?

Onfloo runs on your computer. Only Feedback and the optional usage data use the internet, and only when you choose to.

What data does Onfloo send?

Nothing on its own. Feedback sends your text, optional email, screenshot and diagnostics when you press Send. Anonymous usage data is off by default.
